tokens.bg-art: Ambient backdrop over the background (e.g. a soft gradient)
tokens.surface-hover: A raised surface under the pointer
tokens.surface-sunken: Wells: code blocks, empty areas, tracks
tokens.glass: Translucent panels over artwork (used with blur)
tokens.art-overlay: Over artwork while its controls show (keep it translucent)
tokens.icon-filter: Applied to the app's white icons (e.g. brightness(0.35) on light themes)
tokens.nav-edge: Bar between the navigation and the page (a color or gradient; none keeps it plain)
tokens.nav-edge-width: Width of that bar (it's also the handle for resizing the navigation)
tokens.accent: Brand color: primary buttons, active items, toggles
tokens.space: Base spacing unit (paddings and gaps are multiples)
tokens.nav-width: Default width of the navigation sidebar
